hex_ranthought.mishap.missing_lightning_: at least one lightning rod in the inventory
item.hex_ranthought.fidget.hint: V opens the wheel; sneak-scroll or right-click to cycle; sneak-right-click reverses
hex_ranthought.page.gloopifact.intro: The Gloopifact combines packaged casting with internal iota storage and can be recharged. $(br2)Ported from Hex Gloop by SamsTheNerd.
hex_ranthought.page.gloopifact.craft: This port uses a slimeball in place of Hex Gloop's gloop material.
hex_ranthought.page.gloopifact.patterns: See $(l:hexcasting:patterns/hex_ranthought_gloopifact)Gloopifact Patterns$(/l) for crafting, storage and ravenmind transfer. Except for crafting, these patterns require casting with a Gloopifact.
hex_ranthought.page.fidgets.intro: Cycle a fidget with right click, sneak-scroll, or the V-key wheel. Mind's Orchard can read its selected slot. $(br2)Ported from Hex Gloop by SamsTheNerd.
hex_ranthought.page.fidgets.pen: The pen fidget has two slots.
hex_ranthought.page.fidgets.dreidel: The dyeable dreidel fidget has four slots.
hex_ranthought.page.fidgets.amogus: The rainbow crewmate fidget has six slots.
hex_ranthought.page.library_card.intro: Use the card on an Akashic Record to bind its dimension. While the card is in your inventory, Akashic reading looks up the same coordinates in that dimension. $(br2)Ported from Hex Gloop by SamsTheNerd.
hex_ranthought.page.orchard.intro: These patterns read the selected fidget slot. $(br2)Ported from Hex Gloop by SamsTheNerd.
hex_ranthought.page.orchard.read: Read the selected slot as a number.
hex_ranthought.page.orchard.read_list: Read the selected slot as a single-element list.

hex_ranthought.page.swap_entities.intro: Game of Injustice swaps the positions of the top two entities on the stack. Both must be in range and teleportation must be allowed in this dimension.
hex_ranthought.page.swap_entities.patter: Consume two entity iotas and exchange their positions for the media equivalent of 2 amethyst shards.
hex_ranthought.page.swap_effects.intro: Game of Injustice: Revised exchanges every active potion effect on the top two living entities, including each effect's duration and amplifier. They must be distinct and in range.
hex_ranthought.page.swap_effects.pattern: Consume two entity iotas and exchange their potion effects for the media equivalent of 4 amethyst shards. Casting mishaps if either entity cannot receive an incoming effect.
hex_ranthought.page.phantom_chicken.intr: Tired of being tormented by phantoms, the most accomplished hexcasters finally found a solution: turn them into utter chickens.
hex_ranthought.page.phantom_chicken.patt: Each cast consumes the media equivalent of 2 amethyst shards. The hexcaster's anger is so focused on phantoms that it seems to have no effect on other entities.
hex_ranthought.page.thaumic_shock.intro: An arc starts at the first valid living entity in the list, then jumps to the nearest living entity that has not yet been connected. Its color follows the caster's current pigment. $(br2)Arc visuals are adapted from Thaumcraft 6's FXBolt.
hex_ranthought.page.thaumic_shock.patter: Input a list of entities. Only distinct living entities are connected; dropped items and armor stands are ignored. With fewer than two valid targets, there is no damage or arc. With n valid targets, each takes min(30, 5 + 2 × (n - 2)) damage. Casting requires a lightning rod in the inventory. Every cast consumes one lightning rod and the media equivalent of 4 amethyst shards; without a lightning rod, casting fails.
hex_ranthought.page.spatial_blade.intro: Spatial Blade is a great spell: its actual pattern varies by world and casting it requires enlightenment. It draws a straight cut from a starting position along a direction vector. Input the start position first and the direction second; the endpoint is their sum. Its visual uses the same simple texture style as Thaumic Shock.
hex_ranthought.page.spatial_blade.patter: A living entity is hit only when the segment fully enters and exits its bounding box. Multipart entities are checked box by box. Base damage is 25 by default; damage is the sum of base damage × (length through each box / the longest of its X, Y, and Z dimensions), capped at 200 per entity. If two or more living entities are fully pierced, the spell fails and the casting player takes 2 damage. Media cost is 3 amethyst dust per unit of direction-vector length, rounded up to a whole media unit.
hex_ranthought.page.amethyst_generator: Every minute, the generator attempts to produce 16 items: a 5% chance of charged amethyst, a 1% chance of amethyst dust, and otherwise vanilla amethyst shards. Each product has its own internal slot. Hoppers or item pipes can extract from below; there is no interface. If the chosen slot cannot hold all 16 items, nothing is produced that minute. It only runs while its chunk is loaded and requires an iron pickaxe or better to mine.
hex_ranthought.page.amethyst_generator.b: Flay an iron golem's mind into budding amethyst to turn the block into an Amethyst Generator. This costs 10 charged amethyst units of media.
